title: kube-oidc-proxy Active Directory configuration
description: Configuration of the LDAP backends that the groups of an authenticated request are augmented from, and of where the built mapping is persisted between restarts.

role.description: The part this proxy plays in building and serving the mapping. 'standalone' builds, persists and serves it alone. 'builder' builds and persists it for readers to serve, and is the only writer of the store and the only role holding directory credentials. 'reader' never reaches a directory: it serves what a builder persisted, and is configured without backends. 'builder' and 'reader' share their store across separate deployments, so both require a 'kubernetesSecret' cache; a file cannot be relied on to be shared between pods.

backends.description: The directories to build the user to group mapping from. The mappings of every backend are merged, so a user present in more than one directory holds the union of their groups. Required unless the role is 'reader', which must not configure any.

refreshInterval.description: How often the mapping is rebuilt from the directories. Not used by a 'reader'.

refreshUsers.description: Users allowed to trigger a refresh of the mapping. Matched case insensitively, with or without the OIDC username prefix. If unset, any authenticated user may trigger one.

cache.description: Where the built mapping is persisted, so that the last known mapping can be served if the directories are unreachable at startup. Required: without a persisted mapping the proxy has nothing to fall back on and refuses to start while a directory is unreachable, so turning persistence off is stated explicitly with a type of 'none' rather than reached by leaving this out. For a 'reader' it is not a fallback but the only source of the mapping, so it cannot be 'none'.

name.description: Name of the backend. Used in logs, statistics and errors, and must be unique.

urls.description: URL(s) of this directory. Tried in order until one can be connected to and bound.

bindDN.description: DN to bind to the directory as. If unset, an anonymous bind is used.

bindPassword.description: Password to bind with. Prefer bindPasswordFile to keep the password out of the config file.

bindPasswordFile.description: File holding the password to bind with.

caFile.description: PEM encoded certificate authority bundle used to verify the serving certificate of this directory. Defaults to the host trust store.

insecureSkipTLSVerify.description: Do not verify the serving certificate of this directory. Insecure, and intended for testing only.

startTLS.description: Issue a StartTLS request after connecting. Used with an 'ldap://' URL to upgrade the connection to TLS.

timeout.description: How long this directory has to connect, bind and be searched before the rebuild is given up on and failed. A Go duration string.

userSearchBases.description: Base DN(s) to search for users under.

usernameAttribute.description: Attribute of a user entry holding the name that matches the username of the token. Matched case insensitively.

groupSearchBases.description: Base DN(s) to search for groups under. Only groups found under these bases are mapped onto users.

groupNameAttribute.description: Attribute of a group entry to use as the group name. The resulting emitted name must be unique within this backend; distinct LDAP groups with the same name make the rebuild fail rather than collapse into one Kubernetes RBAC identity.

groupPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to every group name pulled from this directory. Use it to keep the groups of two directories apart.

type.description: How the mapping is persisted. 'none' disables persistence.

maxAge.description: How old a persisted mapping may be and still be served at startup. If unset, a persisted mapping is served however old it is. A mapping that is rebuilt unchanged is not normally written again, so setting this also makes it rewritten once it is halfway to this age rather than left to age out of the store.

file.description: Configuration of the 'file' store. Required when type is 'file'.

path.description: Path the mapping is written to. The parent directory is created if needed, and the file is written atomically.

kubernetesSecret.description: Configuration of the 'kubernetesSecret' store. Required when type is 'kubernetesSecret'. Only suits a directory whose mapping fits in the 1MiB the API server allows a Secret; use the 'file' store for anything larger.

name.description: Name of the Secret the mapping is written to. It is created if it does not exist.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Secret. Defaults to the namespace the proxy is running in.

key.description: Key within the Secret holding the mapping.
